 College basketball games today: Monday's exhibition schedule features Marquette, Vanderbilt and South Florida 
 Three men's college basketball exhibitions are scheduled for Monday, October 19, including Marquette at Green Bay, UAB at Vanderbilt and Saint Leo at South Florida. By Rodney Knuppel | Oct 19, 2026, 7:17 AM EDT Share on Facebook Share on X Share on Reddit Copy Article Add us as a preferred source Mark Byington | IMAGN IMAGES via Reuters Connect College basketball fans have three men's exhibition games to follow Monday as programs continue preparing for the 2026-27 season.
--> College basketball fans have three men's exhibition games to follow Monday as programs continue preparing for the 2026-27 season.
 The schedule features Marquette traveling to Green Bay, UAB visiting Vanderbilt and Saint Leo facing South Florida in Tampa. Although Monday's slate is considerably smaller than Sunday's collection of major-conference matchups, there are still several interesting storylines worth following.

 Marquette and Green Bay provide an appealing in-state matchup, while Vanderbilt gets another opportunity to evaluate its roster against Division I competition. South Florida also takes the floor against a Division II opponent as the Bulls continue their preseason preparations.
